question: What preparatory acts must precede circumambulation of the fire pit?
premises: The ritual substance or site is first made immortal.
Worship is performed as a preparatory act.
Circumambulation is directed specifically to the fire pit.
inference: Circumambulation of the fire pit follows acts of immortalization and worship.
plain_english: Having made it immortal and having worshiped, one should perform circumambulation of the fire pit itself.
